_notes: Local CI targets for Jacques's Portfolio (app/scripts/ci-runner.ts).
petclinic (spring-petclinic-microservices, Java 17) runs every module's tests with Maven.

ghostfolio is an Nx monorepo; npm ci installs about 2,250 packages (about 1.6 GB of node_modules in the clone). Its target stays marked heavy for that footprint and runs only with --heavy or --target api-jest, for the api project. Measured on this host: install about 30 s with a warm npm cache, api tests about 60 s.

targets.name: maven
targets.note: all eight modules; surefire reports collected

targets.name: nx-jest
targets.run: (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error) && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error jest-junit && (JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR=/out JEST_JUNIT_UNIQUE_OUTPUT_NAME=true JEST_JUNIT_ADD_FILE_ATTRIBUTE=true NX_DAEMON=false npx dotenv-cli -e .env.example -- npx nx run-many -t test -p api client ui common --ci --skip-nx-cache --parallel=1 --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit 2>&1 | tee /out/jest.log; echo "nx exit $?")
targets.note: Nx: the api project only, with .env.example loaded the way the repository's own npm test script does (the configuration service requires ACCESS_TOKEN_SALT and JWT_SECRET_KEY)
